identity.description: Nestled amidst the serene forested hills of Katoria Block and nourished by the gentle waters of the Kurar River, Merha Village (मेड़ा गांव) embodies the timeless spirit, agrarian vitality, and collective harmony of rural Bihar.

about.overview: Merha (मेड़ा) is a vibrant rural settlement situated under the administrative jurisdiction of Jamdhaha Panchayat in Katoria Block, Banka District, Bihar. Surrounded by natural sal forests, undulating hills, and fertile agricultural lands watered by the Kurar River, the village stands as a proud community rooted in mutual respect, education, and sustainable rural living.
about.narrativeQuote: जहाँ कुरार नदी की कल-कल धारा और कटोरिया की हरी-भरी पहाड़ियाँ हमारे गांव की पहचान को संवारती हैं।

highlights.description: The scenic seasonal and perennial flow of the Kurar River nourishes the surrounding groundwater table and defines the natural boundary of the Merha landscape.
A critical rural infrastructure link spanning the Kurar River, ensuring all-weather connectivity between Merha, Jamdhaha, and neighboring habitations.
Rich natural woodlands featuring native sal, mahua, palash, and fruit-bearing trees that sustain clean air and traditional ecological harmony.
Gently rolling hills characteristic of the Katoria and Banka plateau region, offering panoramic sunrise and sunset vistas over the valley.
Fertile terraced fields cultivated with seasonal paddy, wheat, maize, pulses, and mustard, forming the backbone of village livelihood.
Serene devotional spaces where residents gather for daily prayers, seasonal festivals, and collective blessings for village prosperity.
Dedicated educational institutions nurturing young minds from foundational middle schooling through secondary high school studies.
A closely knit rural brotherhood defined by shared traditions, elder wisdom, youth initiatives, and collective decision-making.

importantPlaces.description: The heart of our community in Jamdhaha Panchayat, surrounded by greenery, residential wards, traditional courtyards, and agricultural lands.
The primary river system flowing alongside the village, supporting seasonal irrigation, local ecology, and serene riverside landscapes.
A landmark bridge across the Kurar River that connects villagers to main roads, markets, schools, and healthcare facilities even during monsoon months.
The Gram Panchayat center and local hub for administrative affairs, weekly markets, public services, and secondary schooling.
An important nearby locality in the Katoria-Jamdhaha belt known for its geographic junction and close social ties with Merha.
A closely connected neighboring village sharing cultural traditions, agricultural pathways, and regional fellowship with Merha.
An adjoining settlement in the local panchayat zone connected through rural roads and shared community life.

education.ctaQuote: Education is the future of our village.
education.ctaQuoteHi: शिक्षा ही हमारे गांव के उज्ज्वल भविष्य की आधारशिला है।
education.summary: Merha Village places strong emphasis on foundational literacy, higher secondary completion, and digital awareness for every child in the community.

pillars.description: Accessible foundational schooling providing primary literacy, numeracy, midday meals, and co-curricular encouragement for village children.
Secondary education pathway via the Jamdhaha / Katoria high school network, enabling students to pursue board examinations in science, arts, and commerce.
Ongoing community efforts encouraging 100% school enrollment, equal educational opportunities for daughters and sons, and prevention of school dropouts.
Supporting village youth preparing for board exams, scholarships, technical diplomas, and public service careers through peer guidance.

culture.intro: Our cultural identity is woven around agrarian rhythms, reverence for nature, and collective harmony. Exact historical dates and specific local traditions can be customized by village elders and administrators.

items.description: Seasonal and sacred celebrations where families return home, decorate courtyards, and observe auspicious rituals together along the river and village shrines.
Preserving regional spoken heritage, folk melodies, traditional hospitality (अतिथि सत्कार), and seasonal harvest customs passed down through generations.
Village temples serve as peaceful centers of devotion, evening prayers, and collective spiritual gatherings.
items.editableNote: Editable list of village deities and shrine names

items.description: Everyday village life thrives in shared spaces—morning discussions, cooperative farming seasons, and supporting neighbors in times of celebration or need.
Deep respect for the Kurar River, surrounding forests, and agricultural land forms the core of Merha's sustainable rural way of life.
Regardless of background, residents stand united for village cleanliness, infrastructure care, and peaceful coexistence.
